# Curve

> Curve is a free, browser-based SVG editor. Every shape stays the SVG element you drew (rect, circle, ellipse, line, polyline, polygon, path, text, image, use) and is edited through its own on-canvas points, so saved files remain clean, readable SVG. Files stay on your computer: nothing is uploaded. Built with DAI Studio.

Curve runs entirely in the browser as a static web app and can be installed as a PWA that opens `.svg` files. It is also embeddable: DAI Studio uses it as its SVG editor.

## Use Curve

- [Open the editor](https://curve.by.dai.studio/): draw, edit and export SVG in the browser

## Features

- Shape editing: native editor points for every SVG shape; paths keep their original commands (relative/absolute, shorthand) when edited
- Drawing tools: rectangle, ellipse/circle, line, polygon, star, pen, pencil, text
- Style and geometry inspector: fill, stroke, opacity, fonts, position, size, rotation, and an attribute editor with number, colour and keyword fields
- Layers and arrange: reorder, group/ungroup, align, distribute, flip, lock, hide
- Symbols and definitions: edit `<symbol>`s through their `<use>` instances; inspect gradients, filters, markers and other `<defs>`
- Clipboard and import safety: copy/paste SVG between documents and apps; scripts and event handlers are stripped on import
- Files and export: open/save local files, autosave in the browser, PNG export, minified SVG

## About

- [DAI Studio](https://dai.studio): the AI design and planning tool Curve was specified and built with
- [Source code](https://github.com/dai-studio/curve): the Curve repository on GitHub
